t: Prompt Fu: Absolute Path Certainty for AI Context Indexing
s: The Prompt Fu methodology enhances AI context indexing by implementing 'Absolute Path Certainty' and hyper-detailed manifests to prevent LLMs from getting lost, transforming concatenated text into navigable, deterministic insight.
sub: Absolute Path Certainty for LLM context
Hyper-detailed Manifests as Table of Contents
Addressing the 'Lost in the Middle' problem for LLMs
Programmatic context management for AI interfaces
Precision in AI storytelling and world-building
